A backup file holds your playlist logins, so keep it somewhere private. For a direct copy between two boxes, Transfer to another device sends the same data encrypted over your Wi-Fi.
A backup is a copy of this device’s playlists, settings, sports picks, favorites, channel links and channel names. It is kept inside the app; use your phone below to keep a copy somewhere else.
A transfer replaces the receiving device’s playlists, settings, sports picks, favorites and channel links. Anything only on that device is lost.

Projectivy and other launchers
Projectivy keeps its own picture for each app, and its chooser only offers pictures already on this device. Save one below, then set it per app with "From picture". In Projectivy, turn off Settings > Appearance > Categories > Tint custom icons so the colors are left alone.

Strip the padding providers add to every name — region tags, quality markers and slot numbers. The playlist is never edited: clean names are saved as renames, so a provider update cannot undo them.

These are handled by the TV itself and never reach the app, so they cannot be remapped.
These are two different settings, not two versions of one. Start-up buffering decides how much a stream collects before it plays; the live buffer only applies to live channels and holds extra video so provider dropouts do not interrupt the picture. Change either on its own.
